name: Georgette Kerr
title: Owner & Founder
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Gentle Sleep Coach · 25+ Years
bio: Georgette became a certified postpartum doula over 25 years ago and founded After the Stork out of a genuine desire to support new families. She built the business organically — moms sharing her phone number with friends — and grew it into a LOVE Award-winning service. She has four grown children and seven grandchildren of her own. She attended the intensive three-month Gentle Sleep Coach training program and makes herself available to all After the Stork families to guide infant sleep at no additional charge.

name: Ashley Morrison
title: General Manager
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Elementary Education · Child Development
bio: Ashley is Georgette's oldest daughter. She spent her early college years as a full-time nanny, became a certified elementary school teacher with extensive child development training, and received her postpartum doula training twenty years ago. Now a mother of four boys ages nine to eighteen, Ashley brings a grounded, practical understanding of family life to her role managing After the Stork's operations.

name: Allison Hart, MS RD IBCLC
title: Lactation Consultant
credentials: International Board Certified Lactation Consultant · Registered Dietitian · West Chester University
bio: Allison is Georgette's youngest daughter and holds a master's degree in dietetics from West Chester University. As a Registered Dietitian she had the rewarding experience of counseling clients toward their health goals. Allison went on to earn her IBCLC credential — the highest level of breastfeeding training available. She lives by the team's mantra Georgette has instilled in the whole After the Stork team: your goals are our goals. Allison has two young children of her own who make her home a place of lots of girly giggles.

name: Alexis "Lexxi"
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: DONA-Trained Postpartum Doula · Newborn Care Specialist
bio: Since 2006, Alexis/Lexxi has been providing newborn care to families adjusting to life with a new baby. She is incredibly highly requested and we are thrilled to be working with Lexxi. Alexis has a Bachelor's degree in Social Work with an emphasis on Child Welfare. Lexxi is a trained DONA birth doula and a newborn care specialist. In addition to her education and certifications, Alexis has extensive hands-on experience initiating and establishing newborn feeding schedules, healthy sleep habits, diapering, soothing techniques, etc. Alexis has always had a passion for helping families thrive. Her previous experience with serving families in a social work role has provided her with an excellent background as she supports new families as a postpartum doula. Alexis uses both disciplines in her efforts to offer quality care and service to families during the postpartum transition.

name: Allie
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Allie is a caring birth and postpartum doula, childbirth educator, and passionate advocate for maternal and infant health. She also is a medical technician and has worked with mothers and newborns in the labor and delivery division of the hospital. Allie loves working with multiples as well as singletons. When in school to be a medical technician, Allie’s Women Health course ignited a passion for caring for mothers and babies through the postpartum period. Allie went on to train as a Full Spectrum Doula with Indie Birth, which emphasized a wholistic approach, integrating body, mind, and spirit. Beyond her professional endeavors, Allie has a deep love for animals, reflecting her nurturing heart.

name: Alysia
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Alysia (pronounced like Alicia) is a trained postpartum doula and the mom to two school aged little girls. Alysia took multiple birth classes while pregnant and has always enjoyed immersing herself in information about all things baby related. She breastfed both her daughters for over a year each. While raising her daughters, she has also supported other moms by watching additional babies in her home. Alysia almost always has a baby in her arms and wouldn't have it any other way. She is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International and loves supporting parents as they adjust to life with a newborn.

name: Amanda
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Amanda is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International and a proud mother of two little boys who are Irish twins. Her second son was born incredibly premature and spent many weeks in the NICU, giving Amanda firsthand experience caring for the most fragile and tiniest of babies, born in the peek of the the pandemic. Through this journey, she developed a deep understanding of the seriousness of premature birth and the intense mental and physical exhaustion parents experience as they support and advocate for their newborn. Amanda brings this compassion and insight into her work with families, offering steady, knowledgeable, and empathetic postpartum support. She is a strong breastfeeding advocate while also honoring that there are many loving ways to feed a baby. In addition to her two sons, Amanda is part of a joyful Brady Bunch family. Her "other half" brought his four teenage daughters into Amanda's life, including a set of twins. Amanda truly loves children and often shares that she is especially obsessed with newborn babies. Our clients love Amanda's passion for cleanliness as it allows parents to rest, recovery, and bond with their baby rather than worrying about dishes or laundry. Her nurturing presence, dedication, and hands-on support make her a trusted and comforting resource for families during the postpartum period.

name: Ambria
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: DONA-Trained Postpartum Doula · Newborn Care Specialist
bio: Ambria is a DONA-trained postpartum doula with a true passion for newborns and supporting growing families. Her journey in childcare began many years ago, working in several prestigious early childhood centers and as a long-term nanny for a family she cared deeply for. Over the years, she has developed a wealth of hands-on experience and a natural understanding of babies and their unique needs. Committed to providing exceptional care, Ambria sought out some of the most respected in-person trainings available and completed both her Newborn Care Specialist training and DONA Postpartum Doula training. Her dedication to continuing education reflects her desire to offer families knowledgeable, evidence-based support during the early weeks and months after birth. Ambria is the kind of person to arrive a few minutes early and go the extra mile while in the homes of After the Stork clients. While she may look young, Ambria brings decades of newborn care experience and possesses a remarkable gift for connecting with babies. They seem to sense the love and calm she brings, and families quickly recognize the warmth, confidence, and gentle presence that make her such a special part of the postpartum journey.

name: Amie E.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Amie is a compassionate postpartum doula trained through Birth Arts International with a lifelong love for babies. As the youngest of five children, Amie naturally became the go-to caregiver as her older siblings began growing their families, nurturing her confidence and ease with newborns from an early age. She went on to care for many families as a trusted babysitter and eventually advanced to overnight newborn care, including supporting a family with twin newborns. It was during those quiet overnight hours that Amie discovered the unique sweetness of caring for newborns in the stillness of the night—an experience that deeply shaped her passion for postpartum work. Amie’s love for newborns continues to grow with every tender interaction, and families quickly feel her calm, nurturing presence. She is also wonderful with dogs, often winning over even the most cautious pets with her gentle demeanor. Amie truly loves being in the home during the tender postpartum weeks, providing attentive care to both babies and their parents as families find their footing in this precious new chapter.

name: Amy O.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Amy is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International. She has always been in love with newborns and has been caring for babies her whole life. Amy spent several years as a nanny, and then went on to become a mother to little three boys who are now all school aged. She made it her life’s work to care for little ones and has gained extensive knowledge through her many years working with newborns. She loves supporting new parents as they welcome their own bundles of joy home.

name: Angely
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Angely is a proud mom of three school-aged girls, including a set of twins. With her daughters now entering their teen years, she’s delighted to have a chance to care for sweet newborns and support new parents. Having been in the unique position of raising multiples herself, Angely has a special place in her heart for helping families welcome twins or other multiples. She fondly remembers the whirlwind of those early days—busy beyond belief, yet filled with moments she cherishes to this day. A trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International, Angely is known for her kindness, warmth, and genuine care. She is training to become a NICU nurse, a dream inspired in part by her own experience when her twin girls spent two months in the NICU. Working as a postpartum doula allows her to continue to pursue her education while working in the field she is passionate about—postpartum care. Angely is honored to serve After the Stork clients, and she is deeply committed to helping parents feel confident, supported, and cared for from the very first days home during this important life transition.

name: Ashley B (Main Line)
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: After the Stork's Postpartum Doula Ashley brings an exceptional level of care and expertise to every family she supports. With a background as both a NICU and Postpartum Nurse, Ashley offers a depth of experience that sets her apart in the world of postpartum care. She has spent years caring for the most delicate and medically fragile infants, giving her a calm confidence and highly trained eye that new parents find incredibly reassuring. Known for her gentle approach and thorough knowledge, Ashley has guided countless mothers through their first latch moments—helping to establish a strong foundation for breastfeeding with patience and skill. Her extensive training ensures that each family receives the highest level of professional support during the tender first weeks after birth. Ashley’s calm presence, clinical expertise, and deep compassion make her a true partner for families navigating the early postpartum period. Whether caring for a premature newborn or supporting a first-time mom through emotional and physical recovery, Ashley is a trusted and steady guide every step of the way.

name: Ashley B (Philly)
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Ashley B is a postpartum doula with a lifelong passion for caring for newborns and supporting families during the earliest months of life. Her journey began with over 15 years of experience as a nanny, where she developed a deep understanding of the unique rhythms, needs, and cues of newborn babies. It was during this time that her love for infant care truly took root and grew into a calling. Ashley went on to become a Child Life Specialist, working at one of the city’s most prestigious hospitals. In this role, she supported newborns, children, and their families through some of life’s most challenging moments, providing compassionate, developmentally informed care during times of stress and transition. These experiences shaped her calm presence, clinical insight, and ability to meet families where they are. As a postpartum doula trained through Birth Arts International, Ashley combines her extensive hands-on experience with evidence-based education and a deeply nurturing approach. She is known for her professionalism, attentiveness, and genuine love for babies, offering families confidence and peace of mind during the early postpartum period. Ashley takes pride in providing thoughtful, individualized support, ensuring each family feels cared for, respected, and supported as they settle into life with their new baby.

name: Ashley W.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Ashley W, a certified postpartum doula through Birth Arts International, has over ten years of experience caring exclusively for newborns. A mother of three, Ashley has long been passionate about caring for babies. Incredibly warm and caring, she brings a comforting presence to every family she supports and is always ready to help wherever needed. We are thrilled to have Ashley as part of our postpartum doula team.

name: Audrey
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Audrey is a dedicated postpartum doula who has been a valued member of the After the Stork team for many years. With her warm presence and easygoing nature, it takes just a few minutes of conversation to feel like you’ve known her forever. A loving mother of four—now well beyond their baby years—Audrey brings both personal experience and professional expertise to the families she supports. Her genuine love for babies is unmistakable; she’s happiest with a newborn in her arms and takes pride in helping new parents feel confident and cared for. Audrey is most often scheduled with our Center City families, where she’s known for her calming presence, reliability, and deep passion for helping parents enjoy those precious early months with their new baby.

name: Brandy
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Originally from New York City, Brandy is thrilled to now call Philadelphia home. A Certified Full Spectrum Doula through The Mothership Institute, Brandy has a deep-rooted passion for all things related to birth and babies. She has dedicated her life to supporting mothers through the beautiful, transformative, and sometimes challenging journey of parenthood. As a loving mother herself, Brandy truly understands the importance of nurturing not just the baby but the entire family during the postpartum period. Brandy is trained in the process of placenta encapsulation, an ancient tradition known to support mothers in their postpartum recovery. She not only performs placenta encapsulations for new mothers but also teaches classes to empower other women to learn the art and benefits of this powerful practice. Brandy has studied the healing effects of herbs and offers herbal support to mothers who wish to integrate these natural remedies into their healing journey. With her extensive training and genuine love for helping families, Brandy is an invaluable asset to those she serves. Brandy’s unwavering dedication to supporting women through their postpartum journey makes her a compassionate and trusted ally for new mothers, and her work continues to touch the lives of many in the Philadelphia area and beyond.

name: Brielle
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Brielle is a labor and delivery nurse and also a postpartum nurse. After the Stork is so honored to also have Brielle working with us as a postpartum doula. She loves personal experience of caring for babies one on one and helping parents adjust to parenthood in their own homes. Her extensive education and nursing experience is a huge asset to us at After the Stork and we are thrilled to have Brielle on our team of doulas.

name: Candace
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Candace is a certified postpartum doula through Birth Arts International, bringing warmth, wisdom, and deep empathy to every family she supports. A devoted mother of two sons in college, a daughter in high school, and two beloved fur babies, Candace understands the full spectrum of parenting—from sleepless nights to joyful milestones. Originally from New York City, Candace began caring for children as a babysitter and nanny throughout high school, college, and graduate school. She relocated to the Philadelphia area in the late 1990s, where she raised her family and became deeply rooted in the local community. Candace is passionate about postpartum care and treasures the opportunity to support families during one of the most transformative times in their lives. Known for her calming presence and genuine compassion, she is adored by the families she works with. She finds great joy in nurturing newborns through the night so that parents can rest and wake up refreshed, ready to bond with their baby. In addition to her work as a doula, Candace is a writer and yoga and Pilates instructor. She loves cooking, reading, traveling, and spending quality time with her family.

name: Cerise
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Cerise is a postpartum doula trained through DONA, with a deep passion for supporting families during the early weeks after birth. She is committed to coming alongside parents with compassion, equipping them with the knowledge, confidence, and tools they need to feel empowered as they step into their new role. Cerise has extensive experience caring for babies, toddlers, and children, as she has been a highly sought after caregiver for many years. Known for building strong, lasting relationships, she is often invited to stay with families long-term because of the great value her presence adds to the home. Cerise is thrilled to focus her work on the postpartum period, offering hands-on support during such a tender and important time. Cerise brings a calm, nurturing presence into each home, helping parents feel confident, supported, and truly cared for.

name: Chelsea
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Chelsea is a trained postpartum doula through DONA (Doulas Of North America). She has completed an additional Postpartum Doula certification through Modern Doula and is a trained CLC (Certified Lactation Counselor). As the loving mother of three, she understands firsthand the joys and challenges that come along with welcoming a new baby. Chelsea is compassionate, experienced, and dedicated to supporting families during the transformative weeks after birth. Chelsea's warm presence brings peace of mind to each family she supports. With a passion for empowering parents and a deep understanding of newborn needs, Chelsea creates a warm and stress free environment where families can focus on bonding and healing. We are thrilled to have Chelsea supporting After the Stork families.

name: Colleen
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Colleen is loving mom of three teenagers. She has spent over a decade working in a prestigious daycare where she worked her way up to the position of director. Colleen is warm and kind and puts new parent’s minds at ease knowing she is incredibly confident caring for newborn babies. She received her postpartum doula training from Birth Arts International and loves helping new parents with their precious newborns overnight.

name: Courtney
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Courtney is a registered nurse and postpartum doula who brings both clinical expertise and heartfelt care to every family she supports. Whether in the home or the hospital, she is known for providing attentive, compassionate care to newborns and steady, reassuring support to parents. With her naturally bubbly and approachable personality, Courtney creates a calm, positive environment where families feel comfortable and cared for. Her strong background in newborn care allows her to guide parents through the early postpartum period with clarity and ease, always adapting her support to meet each family’s unique needs. Courtney has experience working with a wide range of families, including high-profile clients who appreciate her professionalism, discretion, and thoughtful attention to detail. Above all, her genuine love for babies and dedication to supporting families is evident in every interaction.

name: Dani F
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Dani has been a doula for over twenty years, bringing a wealth of experience, wisdom, and compassionate care to every family she serves. She is CAPPA-trained and, as a mother of twins herself, offers a unique understanding of the joys and challenges of caring for multiples. Her twins are now grown, and the caregiver’s heart clearly runs in the family—both have gone on to become nurses. Over the years, Dani has cared for countless families through our agency and has become a treasured resource for parents throughout the Main Line and Philadelphia.

name: Danielle G
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Danielle G. is a proud mom of four school-aged girls and a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International. With over twenty years of experience working with children, Danielle G. has dedicated her career to nurturing young lives in many different ways. Before becoming a postpartum doula, she served as an infant teacher in a daycare and later as the childcare director. Danielle G. holds a bachelor’s degree in Early Childhood Education from Cabrini University and is currently pursuing her master’s degree in psychology, focusing on child and adolescent development. Her deep understanding of childhood development, combined with her extensive hands-on experience, allows her to offer families both practical guidance and heartfelt support. While she loves children of all ages, Danielle has a special place in her heart for newborns. She is honored to help families adjust to life with their newest addition, ensuring parents feel confident, supported, and cared for during the precious early weeks at home.

name: Dionne
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Certified through Pro Doula, Dionne brings a wealth of knowledge, experience, and empathy to every family she serves. As a mother of four college-aged children, Dionne understands firsthand the joys and complexities of raising children. Her own experiences as a mother, combined with her extensive education and training, have fueled her passion for supporting families during the postpartum period. Dionne’s approach ensures each family feels heard, valued, and cared for as they adjust to life with a new baby. With decades of both personal and professional experience, Dionne is deeply committed to serving families. Dionne’s nurturing spirit and dedication to helping families navigate the challenging postpartum period are at the core of her work, making her a trusted ally for those in need of support, guidance, and compassion.

name: ElaSofie
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Ela is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International who brings both clinical knowledge and heartfelt care to the families she supports. She is currently a nursing student at the University of Pennsylvania and has always been drawn to working with babies and supporting families during the early postpartum period. Ela has several years of hands-on experience caring for infants in a daycare setting and eagerly takes advantage of every opportunity to deepen her newborn care skills. Through her nursing education, she has worked closely with babies in both the postpartum unit and the NICU, assisting with newborn assessments after birth and helping care for infants as they grow stronger day by day. A special area of focus for Ela is infant feeding, particularly breastfeeding. She has spent time shadowing International Board Certified Lactation Consultants (IBCLCs), gaining valuable insight and practical experience to better support families as they navigate feeding their newborns. Ela is deeply passionate about this work and genuinely cares for the families she serves. She brings warmth, dedication, and a strong foundation of knowledge to her role, offering thoughtful and supportive care during this important transition.

name: Fazia
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Fazia is a dedicated birth and postpartum doula with a passion for supporting families through the transformative journey of welcoming a new baby. She brings experience working with both singletons and multiples, offering compassionate, informed care tailored to each family’s unique needs. Fazia holds a Bachelor's degree in Kinesiology from Temple University, which informs her holistic approach to wellness, healthy movement, and recovery during the perinatal period. She finds deep fulfillment in empowering new moms and dads as they navigate early parenthood and build strong bonds with their newborns.

name: Folona
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: CAPPA-Certified Postpartum Doula · Newborn Care Specialist
bio: For over twenty years, Falona has cared for babies and children in the homes of her clients. Trained as a Postpartum Doula through CAPPA and certified as a Newborn Care Specialist, Falona combines professional expertise with a natural warmth that instantly puts families at ease. Her presence fills the home with joy, and she has a gift for creating a calm, reassuring environment that allows parents to rest, recover, and fully enjoy their new baby. Beloved by every family she works with, Falona is more than a doula—she is a steady, joyful presence who makes the early days of parenthood feel lighter, more supported, and filled with confidence. Families often say that Falona’s reputation precedes her. Friends and community members frequently refer her by name, recommending her with the highest confidence to new parents who need gentle, knowledgeable support. Her name has become synonymous with trust, warmth, and exceptional care, which is why so many families seek her out again and again.

name: Heather E.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International · Newborn Care Specialist
bio: Heather is a Certified Postpartum Doula through Birth Arts International and a trained Newborn Care Specialist through The Newborn Care Training Academy. Known affectionately as a “baby whisperer,” Heather has a natural gift with infants and a lifelong love for caring for children. She began her career as a full-time nanny and quickly found her niche in supporting families with newborns. Over the years, Heather has become highly sought-after for her calm presence, deep knowledge, and intuitive care during the earliest days of parenthood. Heather now works exclusively with newborns offering both daytime and overnight care depending on the family's needs. Her dedication, skill, and soothing presence help parents rest and recover, knowing their baby is in experienced and loving hands.

name: Heather K.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Heather loves babies and has been working with infants and children for 30 years. She is a mom of four including a set of twins. Heather became a postpartum doula in 2012 and has loved working in this role-- it suits her perfectly. She has great organization skills and loves to help parents feel at ease when they wake up to start their day.

name: Jenn T
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: As a mother of three and a passionate postpartum doula, Jenn understands firsthand the challenges and beauty of the fourth trimester. With an incredibly nurturing spirit, she finds immense joy in supporting parents through this tiring, yet transformative period. To her, the work of being a postpartum doula is a privileged position. She is honored to care for the most precious tiny people and also the parents during one of their most vulnerable and precious moments. Jenn provides competent, compassionate, and experienced support to mothers and families as they navigate the early weeks of parenthood. She is deeply committed to helping mothers cherish the bond they share with their newborns, offering both emotional and physical support that allows them to rest, recover, and connect. Her goal is to ensure that new parents can fully embrace this special time, free from stress and uncertainty as she helps parents to get some rest in these early weeks.

name: Joy
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Joy is a certified birth and postpartum doula trained through DONA, with many years of experience supporting families through pregnancy, birth, and the newborn stage. Her clients can immediately sense that she is a seasoned and confident doula who brings both expertise and warmth to every family she serves. Joy lives life to the fullest and intentionally fills her days with the things she loves. Baby snuggles are at the top of that list, but she also enjoys traveling and spending time with her family. She finds deep fulfillment in nurturing new parents through one of life’s most meaningful transitions. Supporting families during these tender, life-changing moments brings her genuine joy—just as her name suggests.

name: Joyce
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Joyce is a highly requested After the Stork doula. She has been with our company since August 2012! For more than a decade, Joyce has been caring for (mostly) Main Line families as they welcome their newborn babies home. Joyce is the mom of two boys who are now in their teen years and beyond. She says she enjoys her work greatly and finds it very fulfilling “because it is rewarding to help moms and families who are welcoming home new babies.” She loves bringing some peace and comfort to the family during this stressful and exciting time. “I feel honored that they invite me into their homes to care for their precious newborns.” Her clients love her, and she is one of our most highly requested doulas.

name: Kara
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: With a passion for both people and science, Kara obtained a Bachelor of Arts in Anthropology from Penn State University. Throughout college and following graduation, she worked full time as a professional nanny caring for multiples 50 hours each week and babysitting for countless newborns on the weekends. To complement more than a decade of childcare experience with a formal education, she pursued an Early Childhood Education Certificate. Motivated to eliminate the disparities in maternal health and child development emphasized throughout her education coursework, Kara applied to and was successfully accepted into Drexel’s Maternal and Child Health Graduate program. Additionally, Kara has completed her postpartum doula training, broadening the support that she is able to provide to both parents and newborns. In her free time, she is passionate about working with maternal health nonprofits and fostering rescue dogs.

name: Katharine
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Katharine has always had a deep love for babies and a natural gift for caring for others. As a mother of two girls, she understands firsthand how transformative—and at times challenging—the postpartum journey can be. Before becoming a doula, she spent years working as a private nanny, where she discovered how much she enjoyed nurturing newborns and supporting new parents. With her high emotional intelligence and compassionate spirit, Katharine is exceptionally attuned to the needs of both mothers and their babies. Driven by her desire to help others, she also became an EMT—a true “helper” at heart in every sense. Her passion for supporting families deepened even further after helping her sister care for her NICU baby. That experience inspired Katharine to follow her heart and become a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International—and we couldn’t be happier that she did. Our clients often describe her as gentle, kind, and nurturing. Her calm presence and caring nature bring comfort and peace to new parents, especially during those tender overnight hours. A true night owl, Katharine finds joy in spending the quiet hours tending to the smallest and sweetest babies throughout the Philadelphia area.

name: Kathy
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Kathy is a trained RN who specialized in maternity and newborn nursery. “I enjoy being able to use this experience to help me when working as a postpartum doula.” Kathy is the mother of four daughters and is a grandmother to three grandsons. She left the medical field when her children were small to open her own at-home child care business, and she became a doula because she really enjoys getting to be a part of this special time in new parents’ lives. She loves the support and resources she gets from After the Stork so that she can provide quality postpartum doula care.

name: Kayla
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Kayla is a postpartum doula who has been professionally trained through Birth Arts International and is also an experienced mother of three school-aged children. Her journey in childcare began as a nanny, where she supported families with infants and quickly developed a deep appreciation for nurturing growing families. One especially rewarding role involved caring for infant twins and their toddler brother—a challenging but formative experience. She later worked in the infant room of a daycare, gaining valuable hands-on experience in early childhood development. Now that her own children are more independent, Kayla finds great fulfillment in supporting other families and reliving the beauty of the infant stage. She brings both professional insight and personal understanding to her doula work, offering calm, capable, and compassionate care. In addition to her work as a doula, Kayla is pursuing a degree in social work at Rutgers University. She has a deep passion for helping others and is committed to lifelong learning so she can better support families and meet their unique needs. Kayla approaches every home with empathy and a sincere desire to make a meaningful difference during one of life’s most transformative seasons.

name: Kerry
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Kerry has been a dedicated member of the After the Stork team for well over a decade. She is beloved by the many families she’s supported throughout Warrington, Doylestown, Newtown, and all along the Main Line. Gentle, sweet, and deeply compassionate, Kerry brings warmth and calm to every home she enters—our clients consistently praise the care and confidence she provides. As a mother of three school-age children, Kerry understands the emotional and physical demands that come with welcoming a new baby. Over the years, she has gained a wealth of hands-on knowledge by caring for infants full-time and supporting countless families during the postpartum period. Her extensive experience has made her a true newborn expert and an invaluable member of our team. Kerry completed her initial Postpartum Doula Training with the Active Birth Institute and later pursued additional training through Birth Arts International. She continues to provide expert care to new parents, helping them feel supported, empowered, and at ease during one of life’s most transformative times. We are so grateful to have Kerry on our team!

name: Kitana
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Kitana is a trained full-spectrum doula through Birthing Advocacy Doula Trainings (BADT) and a proud mother of two children. Her own experiences with pregnancy, birth, and the postpartum period deeply shaped her passion for maternal health and whole-family well-being. Through these transformative seasons of life, Kitana gained a profound appreciation for how much informed care can positively impact new parents. Kitana’s approach to her work as a postpartum doula centers on whole-person wellness while thoughtfully following evidence-based infant care practices to support the well-being of the entire family. She considers it a true privilege to walk alongside parents during these sacred early days, helping them find balance, confidence, and joy as they settle into life with their new baby.

name: Laura D.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Laura has been described by families as warm, calming, and familiar. Perhaps it's her lovely English accent, her gentle demeanor, or the quiet confidence she brings into every home she enters. A trained postpartum doula and devoted mother of three daughters, Laura has a natural gift for helping new families feel cared for, supported, and completely at ease during one of life's biggest transitions. Laura doesn't view postpartum care as simply a profession—it is a privilege. She feels deeply honored to be invited into a family's home during those irreplaceable first weeks with a new baby. She treasures the opportunity to nurture newborns during their sweetest, sleepiest, and most precious stage of infancy while creating an environment where parents can rest, recover, and settle into their new roles with confidence. Having navigated breastfeeding challenges with her own children, Laura understands that every family's feeding journey is unique. She believes wholeheartedly that a nourished baby and a supported mother are what matter most. Whether families choose to breastfeed, bottle-feed, pump, or combination feed, Laura offers compassionate and evidence-based support that empowers parents to make the choices that are right for them.

name: Lora C.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Lora has been a cherished member of the After The Stork team for over a decade, bringing warmth, wisdom, and unwavering support to every family she serves. With hundreds of grateful families across the Main Line singing her praises, Lora is one of our most frequently requested doulas—and for good reason. Her compassionate presence, deep experience, and intuitive care have made her a beloved figure in our community. As a seasoned professional and postpartum doula mentor, Lora plays a vital role in guiding and supporting our newer doulas, helping to uphold the high standards of care that After The Stork is known for. Her dedication to nurturing both clients and colleagues alike speaks volumes about the kind of person she is—generous, patient, and deeply committed. Lora is also the proud mother of teenage triplets and was once an After The Stork client herself. Her personal experience as a new mother of triplets receiving doula support inspired her to “pay it forward” by offering the same compassionate care and guidance to others. She understands firsthand just how special—and sometimes overwhelming—the early days of parenthood can be. Lora considers it an honor to help families feel confident, supported, and cared for as they welcome their new baby or babies home. We are endlessly grateful to have Lora as part of our team. She truly embodies the heart of what we do.

name: Lyndsay
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Certified through Birth Arts International, Lyndsay is a devoted and compassionate postpartum doula who brings both professional expertise and a loving touch to every family she supports. As a mom of two teenagers, Lyndsay has always had a natural connection with babies and a heartfelt passion for nurturing new families during the tender postpartum period. Known for her kindness and caring heart, Lyndsay offers more than just support—she brings peace of mind. Clients often say they sleep better knowing their baby is under her loving, watchful care. Lyndsay’s warmth, experience, and genuine love for what she does make her an exceptional postpartum doula and a cherished part of our team.

name: Marissa
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Marissa is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International and is currently in her final year of nursing school, where she is studying to become a maternity nurse. As the oldest of four children, Marissa’s love for babies began early. She fondly recalls treating her younger siblings like her own baby dolls and feeling completely comfortable with a baby in her arms from a young age. That early connection led her to years of experience as a babysitter, nanny, and overnight newborn caregiver for many families. Marissa finds deep joy in supporting families during the precious postpartum period—a time when hearts are full, gratitude is abundant, and the bond between parents and baby begins to blossom. She understands that while this stage of life is incredibly special, it can also come with sleepless nights and very little time for self-care. Marissa believes it doesn’t have to be that way. She loves helping parents carve out time for rest, a relaxing shower, or a quiet moment to themselves so they can feel refreshed and present as they connect with their baby. Babies have always been at the center of Marissa’s world. Known for her bubbly and sweet personality, she brings warmth, positivity, and encouragement into every home she enters. Her mission is to support families through the postpartum transition in whatever ways they need most. With Marissa nearby, parents can rest easy knowing their baby is in loving, capable arms.

name: Marlena
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Marlena is a DONA-trained postpartum doula and proud mom to a son and daughter she loves to pieces. A quintessential Philly girl, Marlena is known for her down-to-earth nature, easygoing warmth, and genuine friendliness—everyone who meets her loves her. Her passion for babies and new mothers shines through in everything she does. Marlena finds deep joy in helping families feel supported and confident as they adjust to life with a newborn. She brings care, compassion, and a little bit of that Philly charm to every home she visits.

name: Sharon
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Sharon is a retired NICU nurse and retired IBCLC (International Board Certified Lactation Consultant) and currently supports postpartum families as a postpartum doula with After the Stork. She has spent career serving in several local hospitals and had an amazing career supporting babies and families in the days and weeks after birth. Her clinical expertise, combined with her warm and compassionate nature, makes her an invaluable resource for the families she serves. Beyond her impressive credentials, is a mother to two grown children and a proud grandma. Sharon is known for her kindness, warmth, and genuine heart for helping postpartum women. She has a calming presence that immediately puts families at ease. Many parents find that after just a few minutes of conversation, it feels as though they've known her for years.

name: Sydney
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Sydney brings a genuine love for babies to every family she supports. Trained as a postpartum doula through Birth Arts International, Sydney has always felt naturally drawn to caring for little ones. Before becoming a doula, she gained valuable hands-on experience working in the infant room of a daycare and later as a nanny, where her calm presence and nurturing instincts were beloved by parents. Now as a postpartum doula, Sydney loves spending her overnights caring for the sweetest and most delicate members of the family. Her kind heart, gentle touch, and attentive nature allow parents to rest peacefully, knowing their newborn is in exceptionally loving hands. If our clients have fur babies, Sydney will be thrilled since she is an animal lover as well. Parents love Sydney’s warm personality, tender care, and the quiet confidence she brings during those precious early weeks.

name: Tenille
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Tenille is a postpartum doula, trained through Birth Arts International. She is the proud and loving mother of six children, including a set of teenage twins. Her deep love for babies and natural connection with children have been lifelong gifts—so much so that her friends have always called her a kidologist. Now in what she joyfully calls her prime years with most of her children fully grown, Tenille is committed to doing only the work that fills her heart. Being a postpartum doula is that calling. Trained through Birth Arts International, Tenille brings a calm, confident presence and a wealth of real-life parenting experience into every home she enters. Supporting families during the tender postpartum season is more than a job for her—it’s a source of deep happiness and purpose. Tenille believes every new parent deserves to be nurtured, seen, and supported. With warmth, wisdom, and a joyful spirit, she helps families find their rhythm, one baby snuggle at a time.

name: Theresa H.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Theresa is an experienced postpartum Doula who has enjoyed working with growing families since 2017. As the mother of four adult children, and grandmother of five, she knows firsthand some of the challenges that new parents may face during the postpartum period... Moms especially! Theresa absolutely loves being part of the supportive Doula care team. Admittedly, she has a soft spot for supporting the families we serve and helping them to care for their precious newborns.

name: Theresa R.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Theresa R earned her nursing degree from Drexel University and went on to become an International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) through Drexel as well. She has worked as both a NICU nurse and IBCLC, bringing a depth of experience that makes her exceptionally qualified for her role as a postpartum doula. Theresa currently loves working in the intimate setting of the home, where she can thoughtfully care for both newborns and their postpartum families. Tender, calm, and deeply compassionate, she is truly a pleasure to have in the home. In addition to her doula work, Theresa works at her alma mater as a high school guidance counselor and school nurse, supporting the same environment that shaped her own growth and education. She is married to her high school sweetheart. Theresa treasures every opportunity to scoop a newborn into her arms and lovingly care for the needs of both baby and family and we are so blessed to have Theresa on our team.

name: Yhalile
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Yhalile (pronounced Ju-Lee-La) is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International who brings experience, compassion, and a deeply calming presence to the families she serves. She is the mother of one grown son and is married, with a beautiful blended family. For over a decade, Yhalile has worked as a high end nanny, making the care of children and families not just her profession, but her calling. Supporting parents during the postpartum period is especially meaningful to her, as newborns have always held a special place in her heart. She finds great joy in helping families feel confident, supported, and at ease as they adjust to life with a new baby. Yhalile is a steady, reassuring presence during a time that can feel both joyful and sometimes chaotic and overwhelming. Her gentle approach and quiet confidence bring a sense of peace and stability, allowing families to rest, recover, and truly enjoy their early days together. Yhalile considers it a great honor to care for babies during these tender first weeks of life.

name: Akira
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Akira is the loving mother of a toddler she’s absolutely crazy about. Her own experience becoming a mom sparked her passion for supporting other families during the tender early weeks of parenthood. Trained through Birth Arts International, Akira discovered the world of postpartum doula work and immediately knew she had found her calling. She is a strong breastfeeding advocate who also understands that every family’s feeding journey looks different. She also loves supporting bottle feeding parents. Akira brings a calm, supportive presence and clear communication to every home she visits. Families appreciate her genuine care, steady encouragement, and the way she helps make the transition into life with a new baby feel a little easier and a lot more joyful.

name: Alison
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Alison loves working with people, and she says that helping families when they have a new baby is “a dream come true” for her. While she has been a postpartum doula since 2013, her experience with children stretches beyond that time; she has a bachelor’s degree in education, and has six children of her own.

name: Amber B.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Amber is a dedicated birth and postpartum doula with a deep passion for supporting families through the transformative journey of childbirth and the postpartum period. A mother of three school aged children, Amber understands firsthand the challenges and joys that come with raising children. This personal experience, combined with her extensive professional training, allows her to connect with parents in a meaningful and compassionate way. Her love for birth work began many years ago, and over the years, Amber has honed her skills and knowledge to become a trusted expert in postpartum care. She is deeply committed to helping families navigate the early days after childbirth, providing both daytime and overnight doula services depending on the week. Whether offering practical support or emotional reassurance, Amber approaches every family with kindness, attention to detail, and a genuine desire to help. Amber received her postpartum doula training through the Community Doulas of South Jersey, where she gained valuable insights and hands-on experience. This education, coupled with her years of experience, has given her the confidence and expertise to support families as they adjust to life with a newborn. Her approach is rooted in compassion and a deep respect for the unique needs of each family. With her extensive knowledge and caring nature, Amber brings both comfort and expertise to every family she works with. Her commitment to postpartum care ensures that new parents feel supported, confident, and empowered as they embark on their parenting journey.

name: Amber M.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Amber M. is a compassionate and highly skilled postpartum doula, deeply committed to supporting families during one of life’s most transformative experiences: the postpartum period. With her specialized training as both a birth and postpartum doula through DONA International and certification through the CoCo Life Foundation, Amber has developed a unique expertise in guiding new parents through the challenges and joys of early parenthood. Amber’s passion for birth work began many years ago, driven by her profound interest in all things related to pregnancy, birth, and postpartum care. Her commitment to continuous learning allows her to stay at the forefront of best practices in the field, offering evidence-based, holistic support tailored to each family’s unique needs. She believes that informed, individualized support can empower families, helping them feel confident and capable in their new roles as parents. Amber’s deep knowledge, combined with her warm and encouraging demeanor, makes her an invaluable resource for any family navigating the postpartum journey.

name: Anastasia
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Anastasia/ Ana is a postpartum nurse and has been caring for postpartum families for years in both the hospital setting as well as the home setting. She anticipates our clients' needs perfectly. She has extensive training to assist our breastfeeding mothers and is overly qualified to care for even our most fragile newborns. She also has the kind and compassionate heart that is needed for this work. We are so thankful to have Anastasia on our team!

name: Anneliese
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Anneliese is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International, dedicated to providing nurturing support to families during the early weeks of parenthood. She is a loving mother of two young children who are now entering their school-aged years. Anneliese understands the realities of newborn life from both personal and professional experience. Born and raised in Palm Beach, Florida, she brings sunshine and warmth to every home she enters. She is known for her calm presence, strong communication skills, and natural ability to help mothers feel seen, supported, and at ease. Anneliese supports parents with patience, flexibility, and genuine care—whether that means assisting with newborn routines, baby laundry, dishes, sharing feeding and sleep guidance with new parents, or simply being a steady, loving presence through one of life’s biggest transitions.

name: April
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: April is a trained and certified postpartum doula through CAPPA who has been supporting families for well over a decade. She discovered her passion for postpartum care long before beginning her own family, and quickly fell in love with walking alongside parents during such a crucial, challenging, and beautiful season. Over the years, April has worked with many families, offering not only practical support but also a calming, nurturing presence. In addition to her professional experience, April is the proud mother of three girls in their preteen and teen years. Her own journey through motherhood has deepened her empathy and strengthened her ability to support families with understanding and care. Known for her kindness, sweetness, and genuine compassion, April brings both expertise and heartfelt connection to every home she enters, helping parents feel confident and supported as they adjust to life with their new baby.

name: Ashley P.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Ashley P. is a certified birth and postpartum doula through ProDoula and a proud mom of three boys, whose ages span from teen to toddler. A clear and compassionate communicator, Ashley brings both professional training and lived experience to the families she supports. She is an advocate for breastfeeding and approaches it with empathy, having faced her own struggles. This balance of expertise and vulnerability allows her to meet parents exactly where they are to offer both encouragement and practical guidance. Ashley is deeply passionate about the meaningful work of nurturing families through the tender postpartum season. She strives to create a calm, supportive environment where parents feel empowered, informed, and cared for as they adjust to life with their newest little one.

name: Ashley S.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Ashley S. is an International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) and mom of six children, four boys and two girls. She has always loved babies and loves not only caring for them, but learning about their growth and development. She has taken many infant growth and development courses and went on to earn her IBCLC, the highest level of lactation education. Ashley S. is usually with our New Jersey and Center City clients. Our parents rest assured knowing a well-educated, loving, professional is caring for their young baby.

name: Becki S.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Becki is a mom of two kids who are now older teens. She has always loved caring for newborns babies. Becki ran a daycare and also worked as a nanny specializing in newborn babies. Several years ago, Becki began watching newborn babies overnight and absolutely loved it. She became a postpartum doula and has loved adding to her expanding knowledge about newborns. She fell in love with working in the quietness of the night as she cares for sleepy newborns. Is there a better job than this?! She takes great joy in helping new parents in this joyous and yet challenging time.

name: Becky M
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Becky is a friendly, kind, compassionate and experienced birth and postpartum doula, trained through DONA International. She has specialized training in breastfeeding support, infant & toddler nutrition, and maternal mental health. She is also a certified reiki practitioner. A bit of a jack-of-all trades, Becky has over 20 years experience working in public service and non-profit, is a trained singer, a former collegiate rower, an enthusiastic school chaperone, and has served as an advisor and advocate for special needs families in the Philadelphia region. A mom of two, Becky made a career pivot after the birth of her second son to pursue doula work. After a very difficult postpartum period that was made easier with an abundance of support and kindness from experienced moms and her larger community, Becky resolved that that no woman should need to navigate childbirth and the postpartum period without compassionate and loving support. Becky offers both professional knowledge and personal insight, while prioritizing the unique needs and circumstances of each family and infant. Her passion lies in walking alongside families-especially mothers. Whether through the profound and emotional journey of childbirth, or during the transformative (and often challenging) postpartum period, Becky’s nurturing presence, unwavering support, and sense of humor help parents feel seen, heard and empowered. Becky cares for babies with the softest touch and most loving hands. She brings warmth and love to each home she works in, and is deeply committed to ensuring each family member feels confident, connected and cared for.

name: Bella
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Bella is a DONA trained birth and postpartum doula who has a deep love for babies and gets her hands on a newborn at every opportunity. She has always been a baby whisper and will get even the fussiest of babies settled in her loving arms. Her work ethic is much appreciated in the homes of our clients as she works diligently to support new parents. Bella is sweet and confident. New parents sleep well knowing their newborn is under Bella's watchful eye.

name: Bernadette
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Bernadette is a trained DONA postpartum doula and the loving mother of three children. Bernadette is passionate about the Montessori Method and has spent her life studying child development between 0-3 years. After her many years of study, she continuously sees how important the early years are. This has led her to working with families during the postpartum period as a postpartum doula. Bernadette loves caring for newborns during these precious moments and supporting new parents during this important transitional time.

name: Beth
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Beth has a passion for helping and empowering women to be the best moms they can be, which is why she became a postpartum doula in 2013. “I know firsthand some of the struggles that new parents may encounter, and I love being able to be a listening ear and encourage them through this journey.” She enjoys working with children and spent five years teaching 5th grade before starting her own family; she is the mom of three boys. “I love the personal connections that this job allows and I also love the flexibility of being a doula.”

name: Brittany
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Brittany is a trained Postpartum Doula through Birth Arts International and also has experience as a NICU Nurse at CHOP. While she loved the fast-paced hospital environment, Brittany transitioned to a more intimate and personal role as a postpartum doula with After the Stork, and we are so fortunate to have her on our team. Brittany’s connection with infants began long before her nursing career, through years of babysitting and nannying. Her sweet warmth, baby experience well beyond her years, and genuine love for newborns shine through in every home she enters. During the school year, she works as a school nurse—beloved by students who are always eager to visit her office—and during the summer months, she dedicates more time to supporting new families with After the Stork. Being a doula is the perfect blend of Brittany’s skills and passions. She finds joy in caring for one baby at a time, offering focused, nurturing support during those precious early weeks. A true night owl, she embraces overnight shifts with warmth and attentiveness, giving parents the peace of mind that their baby is in the most capable and loving hands.

name: Candice
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Candice has been a professional nanny for many years, specializing in newborns. She is also a mom herself. Candice enjoys helping to ease the postpartum period so parents can get a good night’s rest. Candice has a calming presence as she confidently cares for newborns. She has had a newborn baby in her arms consistently over the past 25 years.

name: Christa
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Christa is the mother of five children, and she has been working with children for many years. She has her degree in early childhood education and loves volunteering in her church nursery.

name: Christina
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Christina is a compassionate and dedicated postpartum doula with a deep commitment to providing exceptional care for families during the crucial early weeks of parenthood. With a background as a nurse specializing in infant care at a long-term care facility, Christina brings a wealth of professional experience and a calm, nurturing demeanor to her work. Beyond her nursing background, Christina also spent years in the infant room of a prestigious daycare and as a nanny, caring for infants and cultivating a passion for helping parents. An avid reader and researcher, Christina enjoys staying updated on the latest evidence-based practices in infant care. Her love for learning and her genuine care for others make her an invaluable part of the After the Stork team, where she helps families transition into parenthood with confidence and peace of mind.

name: Crystal
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Crystal is a highly trained and certified postpartum doula through the Active Birth Institute with years of hands-on experience supporting new families. As a mother of five children, all of whom are in school, she deeply understands the challenges and joys of the postpartum period. For many years, Crystal has been a dedicated postpartum doula with After the Stork, where she has built a strong reputation for her professionalism, kindness, and unwavering commitment to her clients. She is known for going above and beyond to ensure that new parents feel supported, confident, and well cared for during the crucial early weeks of parenthood. With her extensive knowledge, compassionate approach, and personal experience as a mother, Crystal provides expert care tailored to each family's needs. Crystal's youngest daughter has special needs which has given Crystal an even deeper appreciation for quality care and the necessity of it. Whether assisting with newborn care, offering emotional support to parents, or helping families establish healthy routines, she brings warmth and reassurance to every home she serves. We are forever grateful to have Crystal caring for After the Stork families.

name: Danielle S
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Danielle S is a DONA trained postpartum doula. She has two children of her own who are now in their middle and high school years. She has been supporting new families for many years as a postpartum doula. Danielle is incredibly easy to talk to. She loves supporting families and caring for sweet babies overnight as the new parents get some much-needed rest.

name: Holly
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Holly is a certified Birth Arts postpartum doula and has been a baby whisperer since her teen years. Holly is the mom to three children. She loves supporting breastfeeding mothers and continues to pursue more training in lactation. Holly is cheery and sweet. Her passion for being a doula is evident as she greatly enjoys supporting families in this precious time of their lives.

name: Jamie
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jamie is a bubbly and friendly postpartum doula who is beloved by our clients. She is the mom to a teenage son and who she is crazy about. Jamie has specialized in caring for newborns her whole life and cared for many newborns as a high-end nanny before becoming a postpartum doula. Jamie loves the mother/baby connection and loves supporting parents during the beautiful and precious postpartum season of life.

name: Jen D.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Jen is a compassionate and dedicated postpartum doula, educated through Birth Arts International. With extensive experience supporting families with both singletons and multiples, Jen offers a calming and nurturing presence during the transformative postpartum period. Jen is known for her kindness, warmth, and tenderness which is seen in each interaction she has with the babies she cares for. She loves supporting families during the postpartum time when time when help is so greatly needed. "We absolutely LOVED working with Jen. She was with us from our first night home from the hospital until our little one turned 10 weeks. She took such good care of our child and on top of that helped us keep the house running and tidy (baby laundry, bottles, etc.) there are not enough words to express how truly special Jen is! She’s an asset to the company and if you can request her, you should." Google Review from Grace Simon

name: Jen R
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jen is happily married with two adult children. She has been a Registered Nurse for over 30 years. Jen has experience working with healthy babies as well as medically fragile babies. Jen has shifted her focus over the last few years to caring for babies as a postpartum doula. “I absolutely adore children, especially newborns. I’m so happy to be a part of the After the Stork Team!” – Jen R

name: Jenae
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Jenae is a postpartum doula, trained through Birth Arts International. She is also the loving mother of a preteen daughter and has always had a deep love for caring for newborn babies. Her gentle nature and nurturing spirit naturally led her to becoming a postpartum doula. She loves helping parents during the weeks following the birth of their baby. Jenae has a background as an occupational therapist assistant with a focus in the functions of breastfeeding. Soft spoken and kind, Jenae has a calming presence that brings peace to any room she enters. She understands the challenges of the postpartum period and offers compassionate care to parents.

name: Jenn T.
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Jenn is a trained postpartum doula with Birth Arts International and the mother of three kids who were born very close together. Jenn is incredibly personable and easy to talk with and our clients feel very comfortable with their baby in her loving arms. She has always enjoyed learning about the mother/baby connection and loves to care for newborns in the stillness of the overnight hours as she supports parents in the postpartum period.

name: Jenna
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Jenna is a postpartum doula trained through Birth Arts International. A true “baby whisperer,” she has been caring for newborns since her teenage years. Now, as her own children enter their teen years, Jenna brings both professional expertise and seasoned maternal insight to her work. She spent many years as a hospital hearing screener, working with babies just hours after birth—a role she loved for the opportunity to support parents and their newborns in those tender first moments after delivery. Today, Jenna cherishes her role as a postpartum doula, providing overnight care for brand-new babies. We are so grateful to have Jenna as part of our team.

name: Jennifer
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jennifer has always been a baby whisper her entire life and loves working in the role of a postpartum doula. Jen is a mom of a 7 year old boy she is crazy about. Our clients appreciate Jen's excellent communication skills and her caring heart. Jen is very relatable and becomes a fast friend of our clients. Babies settle quickly in her caring arms.

name: Jessica
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jessica has spent the past 25 years working with infants and toddlers, first as a nanny, then as a postpartum doula, and then she became a mom herself. Jessica enjoys working as a doula to help new moms and dads settle in with their precious newborns. She loves to use her knowledge of this special newborn stage to help put new parents' minds at ease and answer their questions. Jessica says, "I love helping parents feel confident as they bond with and care for their little one."

name: Jo Ann
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jo Ann a DONA trained postpartum doula and has always been passionate about caring for families in the postpartum period. She is the sweetest lady and our clients are all in love with her. She is warm, friendly, loving, and kind. Jo Ann has two grown children of her own. She has a knack for knowing what you need before you even know you need it. Parents feel confident that their baby is in the most loving arms when their baby is under Jo Ann's watchful eye for the night.

name: Jody
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Jody is a registered nurse with many years experience in labor, delivery, and postpartum recovery. She has helped many moms in the moments during and immediately following the birth of their baby. Her many years of experience as a nurse have equipped her well to be an amazing postpartum doula with us at After the Stork. Jody is also the mother of two young girls who she adores. Jody's extensive background in maternal health gives her a deep understanding of the needs of both new mothers and newborn babies. Jody's calm demeanor paired with her knowledge and nurturing approach make her an invaluable resource to our clients at After the Stork.

name: Jordan
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) · DONA-Trained Postpartum Doula
bio: Jordan is a caring and knowledgeable Postpartum Doula, trained through DONA as a Full Spectrum Doula, with a passion for supporting families during the transformative postpartum period. Her work is rooted in empathy and a deep understanding of the challenges and joys that come with welcoming a new baby into the family. Whether it’s providing physical and emotional support, offering newborn care guidance, or helping parents navigate the early days of parenthood, Jordan is dedicated to helping families thrive during this important time. As a mother herself, Jordan brings a personal perspective to her work, understanding firsthand the ups and downs of the postpartum journey. Jordan is currently studying to become an International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) at Drexel University. This commitment to advanced education allows her to offer informed and personalized lactation support to families, helping new mothers feel confident and successful as they begin their breastfeeding journeys. Her training and experience give her the tools to assist families with breastfeeding challenges and to promote healthy feeding practices that benefit both mother and baby.

name: Julene
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International · Newborn Care Specialist
bio: Julene has been a newborn care specialist for many years and has more recently trained as a postpartum doula with Birth Arts International. Julene's many hours caring for newborns has truly made her an expert in the care of newborns and their unique needs when it comes to sleep, feeding, umbilical cord care, circumcision care, and the many intricacies of infants. Julene loves caring for babies and empowering new parents so they too can confidently care for their new baby. Julene is originally from Jamaica and is the loving mother of three children. She is sweet, kind, and easy to talk with.

name: Julia
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Julia is a trained Birth Arts Postpartum Doula and the loving mother of four children. Julia is trained in lactation and infant sleep and is passionate about providing the absolute best postpartum care to After the Stork clients. With a gentle, sweet nature and soft-spoken demeanor, Julia brings warmth and understanding to every family she supports. Her kind approach and her excellent communication skills create a supportive environment for new parents as the navigate the early stages of parenthood.

name: Karen
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Karen has been a postpartum doula with After the Stork for many years. She has three children of her own who are now almost full grown. She is a trained postpartum doula and newborn care specialist. Karen has her degree in Education and Family Studies. Karen loves caring for babies in this most precious time of life.

name: Kelley T
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: With decades of experience and a deep passion for supporting families through the postpartum period, Kelley Troy is a trusted postpartum doula dedicated to providing exceptional care to both parents and newborns. Known for her nurturing nature and attentive support, Kelley creates a warm, safe environment where families feel confident and supported as they navigate the early days of parenthood. Her vast experience working with newborns and her heartfelt approach to care make her a cherished presence in the lives of the families she works with. Kelley goes above and beyond expectations, offering not only expert newborn care but also invaluable household support to ease the transition for new parents. Whether caring for the unique needs of a newborn, helping with laundry, dishes, or sterilizing pump parts, Kelley’s commitment to supporting families extends to every aspect of their lives during this transformative time.

name: Kelli
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Kelli is a compassionate and skilled postpartum doula trained by Birth Arts International. As a mother herself, Kelli understands the joys and challenges of welcoming a new baby. Kelli has been especially successful in assisting babies who are accustom to “contact napping” transition gently into their bassinet or crib. Her calm and patient approach reassures parents and helps little ones to develop independent sleep routines without stress. Known for her kind heart and her ability to make people feel at ease, Kelli is a natural caregiver. Outside of her work with babies, Kelli has a soft spot for dogs and doesn’t mind a furry friend following her around as she cares for a sweet baby through the quiet midnight hours.

name: Kelly
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Kelly is a NICU nurse who loves supporting families in the intimate home setting as a postpartum doula. Kelly mainly supports our clients during the day. Kelly loves being able to focus on meeting the needs of just one sweet little baby and give her undivided attention to one mom and baby pair. We are so glad to have Kelly on our team.

name: Kim
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Kim is a Maternity Nurse with experience working in both the hospital and doing mom/baby home visits. She is an active grandmother of five including a set of twins. Kim absolutely loves babies and supporting brand new parents as a postpartum doula and feels like she shines in this role. Kim is highly requested by our clients and for good reason. Kim is the mom who everyone wishes they had. We are so thankful to have Kim caring for our families.

name: Kim D
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Kim D has been watching newborn babies for over 15 years. She is passionate about caring for babies and especially loves helping babies sleep longer stretches so parents can get a good night's rest. Kim D. has received training in lactation and is happy to assist moms with breastfeeding. Kim is a confident communicator and she puts our clients at ease knowing their baby is under her expert care.

name: Lana
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Lana is a birth and postpartum doula who lives in the heart of Philly. She began her career working with babies as a highly sought-after nanny in the Philadelphia area, where she became known for her sweet nature, calming presence, and natural ability to help newborns settle quickly. Lana also has a special gift for guiding babies into healthy routines that encourage restful sleep habits, making her a trusted favorite among families. Lana's sister's transformative birth experience inspired her to dive deeper into the birth and postpartum world. She decided to become a birth and postpartum doula through the Birthing Advocacy Training Program, which greatly deepened her knowledge about babies and postpartum care. It is her joy to provide families with restorative overnight rest, giving parents peace of mind knowing their baby is safe and lovingly cared for under Lana’s watchful eye.

name: Lauren
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Lauren has loved babies ever since she can remember. She eagerly babysat and nannied throughout high school and college as she cared for several babies including twins. While she enjoyed working with children at every stage, her true passion was always with newborns. After years of nannying and supporting families with their little ones, Lauren decided to focus exclusively on the age group she excels with most—newborns. To pursue this calling, she received her postpartum doula training and certification through the International Doula Institute. Dedicated to continual growth, Lauren values education and is always seeking additional training and certifications to better support her clients. A natural night owl, Lauren loves working overnight shifts and giving parents peace of mind while they rest. With her bright personality, extensive newborn experience, and gentle, nurturing spirit, Lauren brings comfort and reassurance to every family she serves. Her warmth, kindness, and wholesome character help parents feel confident knowing their baby is in loving, capable hands.

name: Leah
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Leah is the mother of three children and she has a degree in early childhood education, where she was a valued educator for 12 years. She has always been the go-to baby whisperer for friends and family. She says, “since I first heard what a postpartum doula was, I knew I wanted pursue a career in that field. I am so honored to be able to walk alongside families during this incredible time of bringing home a new baby.”

name: Leah
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Leah is the mother of three children. Leah has wanted to be a postpartum doula ever since she started having children of her own over 13 years ago. After the chaotic arrival of a newborn, Leah’s peaceful presence is very welcome. Tired parents sleep well knowing their baby is in Leah’s arms. She enjoys helping families through the precious yet difficult postpartum period. Leah is very artistic and loves making pottery and jewelry.

name: Linda "Lin"
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Linda “Lin” is a postpartum doula and has been working with newborns in some capacity since her college days.
