Lin is a mom to three young-adult children and also a middle school teacher although she isn’t currently active in the classroom. Her main focus in this season of her life is caring for newborns. Lin loves to support new moms and dads through the sweet and challenging postpartum period. Lin understands the challenges that sometimes come along with growing a family and is a kind and compassionate listening ear.

name: Mariam
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Mariam is a DONA trained postpartum doula with a lifelong passion for nurturing and caring for others—especially babies. Her love for infant care began at 18 when her mother gave birth to a baby boy--surprise! While juggling the demands of college, Mariam stepped into the role of a devoted big sister, discovering the joy and deep fulfillment that comes from supporting families with newborns. Now a mother herself, Mariam brings both personal and professional experience to her work. She understands firsthand the emotional and physical transitions that come with welcoming a new baby and offers compassionate, knowledgeable support to help families navigate those early days with confidence and calm. Mariam's dedication to helping others extends beyond her doula work. She has served as a hospital social worker, offering support to individuals during some of their most vulnerable moments. Years ago, she also spent several months in Kenya caring for orphans, an experience that deepened her commitment to compassionate service and global caregiving. Whether it’s her own family or the families she serves, Mariam brings warmth, empathy, and a steady, reassuring presence to every home she enters.

name: Maureen
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Maureen has been caring for newborn babies for over 20 years. Maureen is a sleep specialist and loves to help babies establish healthy sleep habits so the whole family can be well rested and enjoy this precious time of life together. Maureen is the loving mother two one son who is now full grown. She is kind, soft spoken, and hard working. We are thrilled to have Maureen working with us at After the Stork.

name: MeKayla J.
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: MeKayla is a deeply dedicated birth and postpartum doula whose passion for supporting women and families runs generations deep. Coming from a family of birth workers, she has been immersed in the world of maternal care for most of her life. This lifelong connection to birth work, paired with formal training and real-world experience, makes MeKayla a powerful and compassionate presence for the families she serves. Certified through Uzazi Village and continually expanding her knowledge through advanced postpartum training with leading care experts—including international specialists—MeKayla brings a culturally rich and informed approach to her work. Her care reflects a deep respect for every family's unique journey and traditions. With extensive experience caring for newborns, MeKayla offers both practical knowledge and heartfelt support. Her softness, patience, and genuine kindness make her a beloved by the families she serves. Whether she’s guiding a new mom through the early days of recovery or soothing a fussy baby with confident hands, MeKayla’s presence brings calm, comfort, and a sense of steady reassurance.

name: Monica
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Monica is a compassionate postpartum doula, trained through ProDoula and dedicated to supporting families through the early days of parenthood. As a loving mother herself, she understands both the joys and challenges of welcoming a newborn and Monica brings warmth, kindness, and expertise into every family she serves. Monica loves sweet little newborn babies and loves being able to be part of this special time for families.

name: Nia
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Nia is a dedicated and highly skilled perinatal doula, certified through the Pennsylvania Certification Board, and a certified lactation counselor through the Academy of Lactation Policy and Practice. With years of experience supporting families, Nia has a true passion for guiding parents through the postpartum stage, offering both expertise and compassion as they navigate the early weeks of parenthood. Nia’s deep knowledge and hands-on experience make her a trusted ally for new parents in all areas of infant care, having an exceptional amount of breastfeeding knowledge. Nia has supported countless families, including those with twins, she is well-versed in troubleshooting common newborn issues, whether it’s establishing a breastfeeding routine, soothing a fussy baby, or offering guidance on sleep and infant care. Her experience allows her to approach each situation with confidence, providing peace of mind to parents as they adjust to life with their newborns. Her passion for nurturing families extends beyond her qualifications – Nia genuinely loves supporting both singletons and twins during the postpartum period. Her ability to offer calm, practical advice while also being an empathetic listener has made her a beloved resource for parents looking to feel empowered and supported during one of the most challenging, yet rewarding times of their lives.

name: Nichole
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Nichole has been a postpartum doula for over 30 years, beginning her journey into this work when she became a mother herself. Experiencing the profound, life-changing transformation of motherhood inspired her to support other mothers during their own transitions. She pursued years of formal training and is now a Pro Doula Certified Postpartum Doula and Infant Feeding Specialist. Nichole is tender, calm, and deeply respectful, bringing a sweet and nurturing presence to every family she supports. Her extensive experience has led many families to welcome her back for the births of their second and third children—a testament to the trust and care she provides, which she treasures above all. A proud mother of four grown children and a grandmother, Nichole has dedicated her career to supporting families when they need her most. She has thoughtfully structured her schedule to work primarily overnight, ensuring she is available at the times her clients rely on her the most.

name: Paulina
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Our Postpartum Doula Paulina has always had a deep passion for caring for babies. Originally from Poland, her beautiful accent and gentle nature immediately put families at ease. She began her journey in childcare as an au pair, where she cared for several infants and quickly discovered how much she loved supporting new parents and their little ones. After her time as an au pair, Paulina went on to work as a nanny, specializing in the care of young infants. Her nurturing touch and calm presence made her a natural in the role. Continuing to follow her calling, Paulina is now in school to become both a pediatric and OB nurse—further proof of her lifelong commitment to caring for mothers and babies. Our clients love Paulina’s sweet, gentle way and the loving attention she brings to every baby she cares for. Her warmth, professionalism, and passion shine through in all she does.

name: Roniece
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Roniece is a mom of three kids ranging from 10-27yrs old. She has also been an experienced newborn nanny for more than fifteen years and has more than nine additional newborns under her watchful wing. Roniece has a great sense of humor and her motherly confidence gives new parents peace of mind. Roniece is a skill nurse and is studying to be an RN. She anticipates parents needs incredibly well from working in the homes of newborn babies for many years.

name: Ruth
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Ruth brings decades of experience, wisdom, and tenderness to her role as a postpartum doula. Trained through the Active Birth Institute, Ruth has spent much of her life supporting families in the transformative season after birth. Her wealth of experience makes her an invaluable resource to new parents, and her gentle guidance has eased countless families into their new routines. As one of the very first doulas hired by Georgette, Ruth has been a cherished member of the After the Stork team since its early days. Her presence is unmatched—calm, reassuring, and effortless. Parents describe her as the easiest person to have in their home, someone who immediately puts everyone at ease. Babies, too, respond to her soothing touch and peaceful energy, quickly settling in her arms. Beyond her professional work, Ruth is a mother of five children and a proud grandmother to eight grandchildren. She has also opened her heart and home to children through foster care, further deepening her lifelong devotion to nurturing and guiding little ones. With her incomparable experience, deep compassion, and natural gift for caring, Ruth has become a trusted support for both new and seasoned parents. She is truly one of a kind, and families feel fortunate to welcome her into their lives.

name: Samantha
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Samantha brings a unique blend of clinical expertise and nurturing experience to her role as a postpartum doula. With degrees in both Biology and Nursing, she offers informed, compassionate care to families adjusting to life with a new baby. Since becoming a nurse in 2019, Samantha has worked primarily in postpartum care and has also supported newborns with more complex needs. She has years of experience at some of Philadelphia and the Main Line’s leading children’s hospitals, where she provided high-quality, family-centered care during the critical early days of life. In addition to her nursing background, Samantha spent several years as a nanny for multiple families, offering hands-on support and developing deep connections with both parents and children. Her combined experience allows her to bring calm, knowledgeable, and responsive care to every family she works with. Samantha’s approach is grounded, warm, and deeply supportive—making her a trusted guide for families as they transition into life with a new baby.

name: Sarah
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Sarah is a postpartum nurse and in school to be a nurse practitioner focusing her studies on maternal wellness. Sarah enjoys working with parents and newborns in the role of a postpartum doula while she continues her education. Sarah’s extensive education about the postpartum period is a great asset to our team and we are grateful for all Sarah brings to After the Stork.

name: Savana
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Savana is a trained postpartum doula through Birth Arts International who brings both professional knowledge and heartfelt care to every family she serves. With a natural gift for nurturing, she has always been drawn to caring for people and has many years of experience with babies—both as a mother and as a doula. Her journey into newborn care began when her brother welcomed a baby many years ago. From the moment she held that tiny little girl, Savana discovered the deep joy of tending to newborns, and her passion only grew from there. Before stepping into her doula role, she worked as a medical assistant and supported families as a nanny, both of which perfectly matched her love for caring for others. Now, as a postpartum doula, Savana treasures the honor of cradling sweet babies in her arms and helping parents feel rested, supported, and confident. She is known as a true sweetheart—gentle, thoughtful, and easy to welcome into the home. Families deeply value her steady presence and the peace of mind she brings during the early days of parenthood. Outside of her work, Savana is the proud mom of two lively little girls who fill her days with joy and adventure. Her personal experience as both a parent and a caregiver continues to shape her ability to support families with empathy, warmth, and understanding.

name: Shay
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Shay is a DONA-trained birth and postpartum doula who has always been drawn to caring for families during the transformative journey of birth and the fourth trimester. With her warm presence, gentle spirit, and natural ability to connect, she quickly becomes a trusted support for the families she serves. Our clients often share how much they appreciate her steady encouragement and heartfelt care. Outside of doula work, Shay treasures her role as a loving mother to her teenage daughter. We feel so fortunate to have her on our team.

name: Shiya
title: Postpartum Doula
credentials: International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) · Certified Postpartum Doula · Birth Arts International
bio: Shiya is a highly experienced postpartum doula with a strong foundation in breastfeeding support. A certified NMA Lactation Counselor and Breastfeeding Educator, she offers families the best support as they begin their breastfeeding journey. She is currently advancing her clinical training through Drexel University’s IBCLC program, deepening her expertise in lactation to better serve new parents and their babies. Trained through Birth Arts International, Shiya has supported families through the early postpartum period for many years. Her approach is grounded, nurturing, and rooted in both professional knowledge and personal experience as a mother of two school-aged boys. In addition to her doula and lactation work, Shiya is an yoga instructor and dedicated yogi. Her understanding of mindful movement and breathwork adds a calming, restorative dimension to her care. Shiya’s warm presence, depth of knowledge, and holistic perspective make her a trusted and valued part of the After the Stork team.

name: Simonne
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Simonne is a seasoned childcare specialist with over 10 years experience. She has worked with varying age groups of children to include children with special needs. She enjoys working with newborn and new parents guiding them through their new experience. As a childcare specialist she employs proven techniques to calm fussy babies and train them to sleep longer throughout the night. She provides support to anxious parents as they embark on their new journey. She says: “The wellbeing of the parent and child is of utmost importance. I can assure you that I will provide peace of mind whilst working with your family.”

name: Skyler
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Skyler is a passionate and knowledgeable Postpartum Doula who is deeply committed to supporting new families in their postpartum journey. With a love for learning about all things related to babies and breastfeeding, Skyler stays up to date on the latest research and techniques to offer the best care and guidance. Her dedication to evidence-based support helps parents feel supported and empowered.

name: Stephanie
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Stephanie is the mother of one, and grandmother to three. She is a newborn care specialist and postpartum doula and has been working with newborns for over twenty years. Stephanie loves having the opportunity to be a support to new moms and dads. She is loving and nurturing and easy to talk to. She puts every new parent at ease. What our clients have to say about Stephanie...

name: Tiana
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: In 2020, Tiana received her postpartum doula training and certification through The Midwifery Institute. As a mother of two children, Tiana understands firsthand the joys and challenges of the postpartum journey, which fuels her passion for providing exceptional care to families during this precious time. Known for her sweet and soft-spoken demeanor, Tiana creates a warm and nurturing environment where families feel supported and cared for.

name: Trish
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Trish is a warm and approachable postpartum doula, certified through the Active Birth Institute, who brings both personal experience and professional expertise to every family she supports. As a mom of twins herself, now in their teenage years, she understands the unique challenges and joys of parenting during the postpartum period. Trish’s firsthand experience gives her an authentic perspective, allowing her to offer invaluable support to parents navigating this transformative time. With a natural gift for connecting with people, Trish is known for her friendly, personable nature and her ability to make parents feel at ease. She creates a comfortable, open environment where families can feel heard and supported as they adjust to life with a newborn. Trish’s engaging personality and ease in conversation make her a joy to have in the homes of our clients--and we can't get enough of that gorgeous Zambian/English accent. Her genuine love for helping others and her dedication to supporting families during this important stage make Trish a treasured postpartum doula. Whether it’s offering practical advice, emotional encouragement, or simply being a listening ear, Trish’s caring and encouraging spirit ensures that parents feel empowered and confident as they embrace life with their little ones.

name: Vicki
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: Vicki is a postpartum doula who also has her degree in nursing. She is a mother of six children: two older boys in their early twenties and four girls who are school aged. This loving mother and wife has a deep passion for helping families thrive in their postpartum period. Vicki’s ample experience caring for babies both professionally as well as personally sets parents minds at ease as she supports families with gentle confidence. Vicki’s sweet and kind approach creates a safe and comforting space where families feel cared for and empowered.

name: Yalandra
title: Postpartum Doula
bio: With over 15 years of experience in the maternity unit of a hospital, Yalandra is a seasoned expert in caring for mothers and their newborns. Yalandra’s extensive hands-on experience with newborns has equipped her with unmatched skills in nurturing and guiding new parents as they navigate the joys and challenges of welcoming a baby. As a birth and postpartum doula, she provides personalized care, offering emotional, physical, and educational support to ensure a positive postpartum experience. Her approach is grounded in empathy and professionalism, tailoring her services to meet each family’s unique needs. Whether helping with the first nights home from the hospital, breastfeeding guidance, or newborn soothing techniques, Yalandra is a calming and reassuring presence every step of the way of your postpartum journey.
